name: Auto Arena
hook: Buy units, place them, watch them fight.
how: Between rounds, spend gold on units and drag them onto your board. Then they fight another player's army on their own. Lose and you lose health; three of a kind merge into a stronger unit. Last one standing wins.
controls: Tap a shop card to buy, drag units to place them, drag a unit onto the shop to sell
uses: The host's browser runs the shop timer, pairs everyone up and works out every fight; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Every screen replays the same fight from the same boards and seed, so everyone sees the same battle.
Bots take the empty seats and shop for themselves, and a friend who joins takes over a bot's army.
Most games won, shown on the results card.
ideas: Add a unit that summons small skeletons
Give units teams like Fire and Ice with a bonus for three of a team
Make it a space battle with ships instead of units
